data.one_liner: Platform interface for the flutter_dropzone plugin
data.what_it_does: Defines the common API that all platform implementations of flutter_dropzone must expose. It provides methods for dropping files, getting file streams, and retrieving file metadata.
use_when: You need to create a custom platform implementation for flutter_dropzone
You want to ensure consistency across different platform plugins
avoid_when: You only need to use the flutter_dropzone plugin itself
You are not extending or modifying the plugin’s platform layer
strengths: Provides a stable, null-safe contract for all platforms
Keeps the plugin architecture clean and extensible
Supports web, Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux
weaknesses: No runtime functionality – only an interface
Requires a separate implementation for each platform
